items.question: Which plan is right for me?
items.answer: The free plan is ideal for individuals and personal projects. Plus is for professionals and small businesses, Whale for growing teams, and Business for organizations that need maximum performance and security.

items.question: Can I change my plan later?
items.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time from your account settings, and the difference will be calculated automatically.

items.question: What is the difference between monthly and yearly billing?
items.answer: Yearly billing saves you about 20% compared to monthly billing, charged as one payment for the full year.

items.question: Do I need a credit card to get started?
items.answer: No, you can start on the free plan immediately without a card. You only need a payment method when upgrading to a paid plan.

items.question: Do prices include all products?
items.answer: Yes, every plan includes forms, store, links, analytics, and integrations within the limits shown in the comparison table.

items.question: What currency are prices in?
items.answer: All prices are in Iraqi dinar (IQD).

posts.title: Online stores are live
posts.excerpt: Launch your digital or physical store with secure payments and flexible customization — from design to first order.
posts.coverAlt: Merchant managing an online store on a laptop

blocks.text: Online stores are now live on Rukny — a complete product that lets you sell digital and physical goods from one dashboard, built with an Arabic-first experience.
After months of testing with merchants in Iraq, we brought together everything a seller needs: products, orders, payments, and sharing — without stitching together separate tools.
Why launch on Rukny?

items: Physical, digital, and service products — each with the right fields
Secure checkout with cash on delivery
A store page ready to share with one link
Coupons, variants, and order tracking in one place

blocks.text: Add physical products that ship to customers, or digital products delivered automatically after payment. Every order follows a clear path: confirm, pay, notify — you and your customer always know the status.
Our goal is to get you from store idea to first order in hours — not weeks.
Payments and trust
Enable card payments for digital and physical orders, or choose cash on delivery when it fits your business. OTP verification reduces fake orders and improves data quality.

Customization stays flexible: size and color variants, category-specific fields, and Arabic copy that reflects your brand. If you have been planning your first store, now is the time — create a free account and add your first product in minutes.

posts.title: Smart forms with Google Sheets sync
posts.excerpt: Connect your forms to Google Sheets and track responses automatically — no manual exports.
posts.coverAlt: Person filling a digital form with a spreadsheet on screen

blocks.text: Smart forms on Rukny now support Google Sheets sync — every submission appears in the spreadsheet you choose without copy, paste, or nightly exports.
Marketing, HR, and support teams asked for this from day one. Today it is part of the workflow: submit the form, see the new row in the sheet.
How to get started

items: Open form settings and choose Google Sheets
Pick a spreadsheet or create a new one
Map each field to a column
Turn on instant notifications for your team

blocks.text: With webhooks and instant notifications, route responses into your team's workflow — from CRM to internal sheets — in real time.
No more 'export CSV every evening' — data moves with you.
Try sync on your next form: a satisfaction survey, hiring form, or service request. Spend less time chasing data manually and more time reading answers.

posts.title: Rukny solutions for teams
posts.excerpt: Developer portal, WhatsApp API, and dedicated enterprise support — everything your team needs to scale.
posts.coverAlt: Business team reviewing dashboards in a meeting

blocks.text: Rukny for enterprise brings stores, forms, analytics, and developer tools into one platform — with dedicated support for teams that need more than the standard plan.
Companies running multiple channels — store, surveys, and identity page — were losing time across separate tools. Enterprise unifies the experience and gives each team what they need.
What's included?

items: Developer portal with API keys and webhooks
WhatsApp API and Email API for automated messaging

blocks.text: WhatsApp API and Email API help you reach customers inside your workflow — from order confirmations to survey follow-ups — without leaving the platform.
We build with you — not sell you a black box.
Contact sales to define team size, required integrations, and launch plan. We reply within one business day with the next step.

posts.title: Webhooks and APIs
posts.excerpt: Connect Rukny to your apps and receive events instantly — orders, forms, and updates in real time.

blocks.text: We launched webhooks and APIs that connect Rukny to your systems — every new order, form submission, or status change can reach your app instantly.
Developers want reliable events, signature verification, and clear docs. We built the developer portal around those needs — from sandbox to production.
Available events

items: New order or order status update

blocks.text: Register an endpoint in the developer portal, choose the events you care about, and verify signatures to keep data secure. Use the APIs to read orders, sync inventory, or build custom dashboards.
Connect once — receive everything that happens in Rukny.
Review the docs in the developer portal and start in the sandbox before going to production. Technical support is ready to help with your first integration.

posts.title: Unified analytics dashboard
posts.excerpt: Sales, visits, and responses in one place — faster decisions with clear data.
posts.coverAlt: Analyst reviewing performance charts on a monitor

blocks.text: The unified analytics dashboard brings store sales, page visits, and form responses together — one picture before any decision.
Instead of opening three different tools every morning, you see in Rukny: what you sold, who visited your page, and how many people completed the form — in one place.
What can you measure?

items: Form completion rate and field analysis

blocks.text: Compare periods, watch completion rates, and see which product or form performs best. When you need detail, export CSV and share with your team.
One decision needs one number — not ten tabs.
Open analytics from your account and start tracking your numbers today. Every Rukny product feeds the dashboard automatically.
